title: Store consolidation quarantine fix
intent: Holding a place in the verification queue (position 2) for the fresh record; Draft PR #4464 is fully green on CI
progress_summary: Adopted the revoked launch, cleared the adopt escalation, and opened Draft PR #4464. Every CI job is green, including Test (Rust, Windows) where the four store_consolidation tests previously failed. The fix splits WorkStoreLeases into resident/source and releases the source lease before the quarantine rename, because works.lock lives inside the store being renamed and Windows refuses a directory rename while any handle beneath it is open; a sharing failure is now the retryable WriterBusy refusal instead of CorruptInput with a bare os error 5. Remaining: the local verification record, which is queued behind other verification sessions holding the host lease.
